⚠ Duplicate Items Detected
—
Sample Of Duplicates
How should duplicates be handled?
• Skip duplicates — only import the new items, leave existing untouched (safest for re-loading the same file)
• Replace existing qty — overwrite each duplicate's quantity with the value in the file (use after a stock recount)
• Add to existing qty — accumulate (use only for genuine replenishment, never for reloading the same file)
• Cancel — abort the import entirely

📦 Deduct from Virtual Stock
Update Virtual Stock balance based on this order?
What happens next:
• 📝 Reserve — increase reservedQty (semi-deduct, available drops, can be reversed)
• ▶ Release Now — increase releasedQty (full deduct, treats stock as shipped)
• ⤳ Skip Deduction — export the SAP file only, leave Virtual Stock untouched
• ✕ Cancel — abort the export entirely
Deduction uses FEFO across batches (first-expired-first-out) and logs movements to the Virtual Stock ledger.
